title: kit.work-order.v1
description: What a piece of work is before any code exists (docs/CONSTITUTION.md §10, zero post-facto). An agent or person starts work only from an approved work order, writes only inside its declared paths, proves each must-fail test failing on `base` before the change, and pushes only when every gate it names passes. A review checks the work against its order; a finding the gates did not catch is a missing gate, added to the finding-class registry before the fix.

id.description: wo-<number>-<slug>; the number is unique in the repository.

base.description: The commit the work starts from; must-fail tests are proven failing here.

goal.description: One outcome, stated so a reader can tell whether it was reached.

contracts.description: The schemas and API contracts this work creates or must satisfy, as repository paths. Written before the code.

invariants.description: Properties that hold before and after the change; each is proven by a test named in must_fail or by a gate.

paths.description: Globs of the files this work may change. A commit outside them is refused (finding class agent-self-scope).

gates.description: Finding-class ids (finding-classes.json) and canon checks this work must pass before any push.

must_fail.description: Tests written first: each fails on `base` and passes after the change.

depends_on.description: Work orders or PRs that must be merged first (owner/repo#n or wo-id). Empty when none.

approved_by.description: Handles that approved the order before work began. An agent never approves its own order.

owner_steps.description: Steps only the owner can take (secrets, settings, approvals); listed, never done by the worker.
